enabled.title: Boss mode
enabled.what: Turn task routing on or off for this project.
enabled.when: Turn it on when you want the boss to share work across your available tools.

profile.title: Quality versus quota
profile.what: Quality favors stronger answers, balanced shares the trade-off, and frugal favors lower quota use.
profile.when: Choose quality for difficult work, balanced for everyday work, or frugal when quota is scarce.

host.title: Your main coding assistant
host.what: Choose the assistant you talk to: Claude Code, Codex, or another tool using generic instructions.
host.when: Choose the tool where you are working; this changes how routing instructions and workers are delivered.

codex-tasks.title: Codex task worker
codex-tasks.what: Allow Codex to carry out delegated coding tasks using your ChatGPT quota.
codex-tasks.when: Enable it to share coding work with Codex; turn it off to reserve ChatGPT quota.

gpt-reviews.title: GPT second opinions
gpt-reviews.what: Allow read-only GPT reviews, research and critical consensus through Codex using your ChatGPT quota.
gpt-reviews.when: Enable it when an independent review or research answer is useful.

perplexity.title: Perplexity research bridge
perplexity.what: Offer a research prompt for you to paste into Perplexity and bring back manually.
perplexity.when: Enable it for source-heavy research when you are willing to copy and paste.

training.title: Allow providers that train on data
training.what: Permit enabled providers marked as training on your data to receive project tasks.
training.when: Leave it off unless you accept those providers using the project prompts and code for training.

short-answers.title: Shorter answers
short-answers.what: Ask the boss for a brief verdict, changed files, verification, and open issues.
short-answers.when: Enable it when you want shorter replies and fewer output tokens.

providers.enabled.title: Available providers
providers.enabled.what: Enable or disable a provider globally so its models can enter project routing.
providers.enabled.when: Enable only providers you have configured and accept; training providers also need project permission.

caps.title: Provider usage caps
caps.what: Limit the percentage of each provider window available for delegation and raise its routing price as usage approaches that cap.
caps.when: Set a lower cap to reserve quota for other work; project off preserves any global cap.

consensus.title: Independent critical decisions
consensus.what: Offer an independent read-only Codex answer before critical architecture or security decisions with real trade-offs.
consensus.when: Keep it on for important trade-offs; it uses an extra GPT answer and never edits files.

statusline.title: Status line visibility
statusline.what: Show quota numbers everywhere or only with boss mode.
statusline.when: Show quota numbers everywhere or only with boss mode.

context.title: Context handoff threshold
context.what: Suggest a handoff from this token count; also stops a message once after a pause of an hour or more in a large session, before the expired cache is paid for. Turn both checks off with context off.
context.when: Suggest a handoff from this token count; also stops a message once after a pause of an hour or more in a large session, before the expired cache is paid for. Turn both checks off with context off.
